description: A script for automating Chromium dependency updates in the ANGLE project, including functions for parsing DEPS files, calculating dependency changes, and managing git branches and uploads.

classes.name: RollError
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors during the roll process.

methods.name: FindSrcDirPath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the root directory of the project.

methods.name: VarLookup
methods.description: Creates a lambda function to look up variables in the local scope.

methods.name: ParseDepsDict
methods.description: Executes DEPS content to parse dependencies into a dictionary.

methods.name: ParseLocalDepsFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a local DEPS file.

methods.name: ParseCommitPosition
methods.description: Extracts commit position number from a commit message.

methods.name: _RunCommand
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns stdout and stderr outputs.

methods.name: _GetBranches
methods.description: Returns the current active branch and list of all branches.

methods.name: _ReadGitilesContent
methods.description: Downloads and decodes BASE64 content from a URL.

methods.name: ReadRemoteCrFile
methods.description: Reads a remote Chromium file at a specific revision.

methods.name: ReadRemoteCrCommit
methods.description: Reads a remote Chromium commit message.

methods.name: ReadUrlContent
methods.description: Fetches content from a URL as a list of lines.

methods.name: GetMatchingDepsEntries
methods.description: Retrieves all DEPS entries matching a given directory path.

methods.name: BuildDepsentryDict
methods.description: Builds a dictionary of dependency paths to DepsEntry objects.

methods.name: _FindChangedCipdPackages
methods.description: Yields CIPD packages that have changed versions.

methods.name: _FindNewDeps
methods.description: Returns paths of dependencies present in new but not in old.

methods.name: CalculateChangedDeps
methods.description: Calculates dependencies that need to be updated based on DEPS files.

methods.name: CalculateChangedClang
methods.description: Determines if Clang revision has changed.

methods.name: GenerateCommitMessage
methods.description: Creates a commit message summarizing dependency updates.

methods.name: UpdateDepsFile
methods.description: Updates the DEPS file with new dependency revisions.

methods.name: _IsTreeClean
methods.description: Checks if the git working directory is clean.

methods.name: _EnsureUpdatedMasterBranch
methods.description: Ensures the current branch is master and pulls latest changes.

methods.name: _CreateRollBranch
methods.description: Creates a new branch for the dependency roll.

methods.name: _RemovePreviousRollBranch
methods.description: Deletes previous roll branch if it exists.

methods.name: _LocalCommit
methods.description: Commits changes locally with a message.

methods.name: ChooseCQMode
methods.description: Determines the commit queue mode based on revision difference.

methods.name: _UploadCL
methods.description: Uploads the change list to Gerrit for review or submission.

methods.name: GetRollRevisionRanges
methods.description: Determines the current and target Chromium revisions for the roll.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the dependency roll process.
